# #243 Share one evaluation-report gate between Coach AI and Checkpoint reviews
## What to build
The Checkpoint review gate (#222, `service/checkpoint_review_ai.py`) and its evaluation runner are a near-copy of the Coach AI gate (ADR 049, `service/coach_ai.py`, `tests/eval/run_coach_evaluation.py`). Each duplicates `evaluate_gate`, `validate_report`, the report cache, `GateStatus`, `resolve_enable_gate` and `log_enable_gate_at_startup`, plus the runner's `load_cases`, privacy-suite run, report build/write/check and `main`. That is about 120 lines of gate code and most of a runner, so the two gates must be kept in step by hand.
Extract one parameterised "evaluation report gate" (env flag name, report env var, model-identity function, prompt-hash function, report version, suite name) and one shared runner skeleton. Point both features at them.
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Coach AI's behaviour, `prompt_version_hash()` and accepted report format are unchanged; an existing valid Coach AI report still validates, and the production gate stays enabled. - [ ] The Checkpoint review gate behaves exactly as today; its tests pass unchanged apart from imports. - [ ] One implementation of report validation, the verdict re-derivation, and the (path, mtime, size, model, backend) cache. - [ ] Both runners' `--mock`, `--write-report` and `--check-report` keep their current output. - [ ] Full Python suite passes.
